findings.passage: Despite this bipartisan support, partisan operating rules have halted progress on voter ID, preventing Pennsylvania voters from having the final say on the matter.
findings.note: Issue page on her official site; page is undated. It describes House Bill 891, a voter ID constitutional amendment held in committee.

findings.passage: Election integrity is fundamental for the proper functioning of democracy. By implementing robust verification processes, addressing system failures and fostering community engagement, we can uphold public trust in our institutions.
findings.note: Closing lines of the same page, which lists HB 1263 (post-election audits), HB 1883 (cross-checking voter registration records with jury duty lists), HB 2053 (voting machine certification) and others.

findings.passage: To the question of elections, we need a process we can all be confident in, one that is fair and transparent.
findings.note: Her page on the General Assembly's authority after the 2020 general election (written before the 5 Jan 2021 swearing-in; exact date not shown). Lists her support for House Bill 2626 (changes to the mail-in ballot process) and House Resolution 1100 (post-election audit).
